representation_fit.evidence: Brief cell-j08-s08 = edit × single-document, low density, medium hierarchy; source/index.html:34-64 implements exactly that shape as a three-pane workbench (大纲 tree role=tree, form editor, live preview) editing one section at a time; app.js:4 declares single source of truth state.doc with derived outline/editor/preview.

primary_task_salience.evidence: 1280x860 screenshot: center 编辑 pane (title input, status select, body textarea, app.js:521-533) plus all seven structure operations directly beneath it; grid gives editor+preview the flexible columns (styles.css:104 '300px minmax(360px,1fr) minmax(400px,1fr)'), outline is 300px rail — editing dominates the initial screen.

time_to_understand.evidence: Both screenshots read instantly: brand 'Docloom 单文档结构化编辑器' + doc title in topbar (index.html:12-20), panes labeled 大纲/编辑/预览, breadcrumb 文档/概述 (app.js:511-515), first section pre-selected and highlighted in both outline and preview; badge '结构检查 · 完整' states structural health on load. Minor friction: 12px gray hints (--ink-3) require close reading.

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object reached in one click: outline row click → selectSection (app.js:728-730, 815-825); preview headings are also click/Enter targets for the same selection (app.js:783-791); structure-check issues deep-link to nodes (app.js:794-797); all ops live on one screen with keyboard roving tabindex in the tree (app.js:733-747) and Ctrl+Z/Y (app.js:800-812).

context_loss.evidence: No navigation away from the single screen; field edits deliberately skip editor re-render to protect the caret (app.js:303-305 comment '字段编辑不重绘编辑器（保护输入光标）'); commit() restores prior focus after structural ops (app.js:159,171-174) and the modal restores prevFocus on close (app.js:663-689); outline/preview/report all stay visible during edits per both screenshots.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent chrome is minimal (topbar with 4 buttons, index.html:21-30) and per-row structure buttons are hidden until hover/focus-within (styles.css:143-144), keeping the default surface to need; slight excess: the seven whitelisted ops appear twice (outline hover glyphs app.js:428-436 and editor button row app.js:557-565), defensible as duplicate affordances rather than clutter.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt checks fail 3/3 a11y: a11y.contrast=fail, a11y.focus_order=fail, a11y.target_size=fail (measurement-summary.json:13-15; target_invalid:false). Corroborated in source: outline hover buttons are 11px font with 3px/4px padding (styles.css:146-152), pv-status chips 10.5px (styles.css:281-287), meta/hint text #8a94a3 on white ≈3:1 (styles.css:11). Genuine a11y intent exists — aria tree roles (index.html:40, app.js:424), labelled fields, aria-live region (index.html:77), alertdialog modal (index.html:69), :focus-visible outline (styles.css:344-347) — but the measured outcomes contradict it.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defect in either viewport — panes aligned at 1280x860 and 1440x900, layout.responsive_collision=pass and text.truncation=pass (measurement-summary.json:11-12) — but receipt records 5/7 failures including layout.overflow=fail and type.min_projected_size=fail (measurement-summary.json:10,16), implying a rework pass on overflow and type scale even though the captured initial screens look clean.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '结构化编辑与预览一致' is addressed head-on: preview header '与编辑实时一致' (index.html:59), preview derives from the same state.doc (app.js:580-620), body hint '正文将原样渲染到预览' (app.js:531), status field hint '进入预览标签显示' matches preview badges, and both screenshots show the editor's 概述 text rendered verbatim with 草稿/评审中 status chips in preview; selection is bidirectional (preview click selects the outline node, app.js:783-791) and every commit re-renders all panes (app.js:157-176).

defects_observed: layout.overflow=fail in receipt, though no overflow is visible in either provided screenshot
a11y.contrast=fail; consistent with 12px #8a94a3 secondary text on white (styles.css:11, styles.css:59/119/225)
a11y.focus_order=fail per receipt despite roving-tabindex and focus-restore code (app.js:733-747, app.js:171-174)
a11y.target_size=fail; outline hover action buttons ~11px font with 3-4px padding (styles.css:145-153) and 10.5px preview status chips (styles.css:281-287)
type.min_projected_size=fail per receipt; UI uses 10.5-12px type for metadata, hints, and status chips
scores.overall_note: impl-10 presents a purpose-fit representation for the brief's edit × single-document cell: a three-pane structured editor whose outline, form editor, and preview are all derived from one state model, which operationalizes the acceptance seed '结构化编辑与预览一致' literally (index.html:59, app.js:4, app.js:580-620) and is visually confirmed in both viewports. The primary task is dominant and reachable in one interaction, context is preserved via caret-protecting field updates and focus restoration, and structural safety (whitelisted ops, orphan-free delete flows, MAX_DEPTH=4, live 结构检查 badge) matches the success criterion '编辑不破坏结构'. The principal weaknesses are measured, not visible: the receipt fails 5 of 7 checks — layout.overflow, a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size — pointing to an undersized type scale (10.5-12px gray metadata) and target sizes that contradict the otherwise thorough aria/focus scaffolding in the source, implying a rework pass even though both captured screenshots render cleanly. Task completion time, information retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind pilot; the model-judged time-to-understand proxy is high, but that is not human preference evidence.
